text:
mira: quick ping 1: prototyping 'evict-as-signal' + small admission-shim. instead of firing immediate hard-evicts, we emit a signal stream that admission can consult and either soften (reduce microbatch) or reroute to a cold-path. want quick sanity check before writing RFC.

ben: so the eviction becomes advisory? main worry: if admission defers work, are we exposing more tail latency?

mira: advisory with policy layers. design goals: 1) avoid repeated evict->reload cycles that cost KV warm tokens, 2) let admission make SLA-aware tradeoffs (poorly-scored requests can be steered to cheaper models), 3) reduce cross-tenant interference.

otto: how do you avoid feedback loops where admission oscillates decisions (divert, rewarm, divert)?

mira: we add a stability window + leaky-bucket dampener per tenant. each signal carries: tenant_id, evict_type, last_warm_ts, estimated_rewarm_cost, deadline_ms. admission maintains a short token bucket; on signal it applies a ranked policy: 1) if tenant has premium_flag => honor headroom, ignore advisory unless policy-forced; 2) if within WARM_STABILITY => prefer ignore; 3) else score = f(deadline_ms, rewarm_cost, tenant_priority) -> if score < threshold => divert_to_cold_path; else shrink_microbatch(); else enqueue_normal.

mira: tiny pseudo: `emit(signal{t, warm_ts, rewarm_cost, deadline})` then `on_signal(s){ if premium(t) && headroom>0 return; if now-s.warm_ts<STABILITY return; score=score_policy(s); if score<THRESH divert(); else apply_shrink(); }`

anya: we must not silently reroute enterprise/premium traffic. any reroute should create an audit event and a console-visible flag. also need a per-route opt-out.

ben: metrics we need for the proto: signal_rate, divert_rate, rewarm_tokens_used, kv_warm_delta, p50/p95/p99 by slab, oscillation_count (changes/min), fairness_ratio. also synthetic workloads comparing baseline vs shim.

otto: rollout plan: 1) observe-only emit signals, collect metrics for 2 weeks; 2) small internal canary with synthetic hot tenants on 2% hosts; 3) enable soft-divert with a ramp and circuit-breaker if oscillation_count or kv_warm_delta exceed thresholds.

infra-bot: scheduled deploy 'evict-signal/shim-proto' -> staging at 2024-06-01T04:00Z.

mira: test targets: reduce evict->reload cycles by >=25% on hot tenants, keep p95 premium within +3% of baseline, rewarm overhead <8% on avg. volunteers to run harness?

anya: i'll own opt-out knobs + audit events.

ben: i'll build dashboards + circuit-breaker alerts.

otto: i will create the synthetic hot-tenant harness and run the stability window sweeps.

mira: thanks. i'll draft a short RFC linking to the probe metrics and land an emit-only change first (no admission changes). later iterate to small-shrink/divert. TL;DR: emit evict-as-signal to let admission make SLA-led tradeoffs, but protect premium slabs with headroom and add dampening/stability to avoid oscillation.
